text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey has been in top
condition since
receiving her signature
racewear. Fans are even
starting to
recognize her too. When I mention this

to her...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yay! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super effective!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My signature racewear, of course! It's
designed to
use feng shui to attract
heaps of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The main colors are yellow, which
represents joy
and brings good fortune,
and red, which increases
luck in
competitions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are also four petals on the waist to
bring
good luck. I think that detail has
boosted my
fortunes and gotten me
more fans. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I painted my nails a bright blue to
ward off
any bad qi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! If I win wearing signature racewear
that
incorporates feng shui, everyone'll
want to know
more about it, don't you
think?
choice_data_list: You really pay attention to the details, don't you?
You really pay attention to the details, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that... I'm hoping I can
clear up
people's misconceptions about
feng shui a little.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is the study of environmental
luck that
draws out happiness, and it's
based in theory and
calculations. But the
public perception of it is the
exact
opposite, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
People think it's sketchy and fake...
Some people
even call it a scam.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But people only think that because
they're doing
it wrong or because they
give up too fast, before
they've seen any
results.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And those misconceptions end up disappointing the new people trying feng shui and old masters like my dad. That's what always got me, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text: Whimper... But feng shui's a science for making people happy! And everyone wants to be happy!

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do it, Dad! I'll show the
whole world
the right way to do feng
shui and make everyone
happy!

text_block_list.name: Rickey's Dad
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, doing that might take some
time, but
if anyone can do it, it's you,
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll teach people all about feng
shui and
then they'll all be happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's when I became really devoted to
feng shui.
I read lots of specialist books
and tried out
methods from all kinds of
different schools.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I did all that to make everyone
happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I did all that to make everyone
happy!
choice_data_list: Then we've gotta win a ton!
Then we'll have to win a lot!
Your dad will be happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And that's why I need to get
started on
some serious training!
choice_data_list: Then we've gotta win a ton!
Then we'll have to win a lot!
Your dad will be happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a suggestion... Can we
try
incorporating more feng shui into my
new training
plan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Exposure to the morning sun boosts
energy, so
maybe we can move our
indoor training to the
afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Also, since the metal element also
represents
muscles, strength training
should be done facing
west—the
direction that heightens metal qi...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And there are all kinds of other ways
feng shui
can be helpful! But what do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is working hard to realize
her
dream. Wanting to help her to the
best of my
ability, I listen carefully to
her suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hope so!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My dad always tells me that if I find
something I
want to do besides feng
shui, then it's okay for
me to go ahead
and do it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But feng shui's definitely what I want to
do! The
direction of my dream's already
decided!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...And my dad always looks so happy
whenever he
talks about feng shui with
me. And then when my
mom sees him
like that, she looks really happy
too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And seeing them both happy makes me
happy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the five elements—happiness

circulates too! I believe that if feng shui
spreads,
the circle of happiness will get
wider with it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's spread the circle of happiness
across the
whole world, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is striving toward her
dream.
Seeing her, I feel even more
determined to
support her the best I
can.
